los_dc_median.label: Median ED time, discharged patients
los_dc_median.source: CMS Care Compare OP-18b: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 240010 MAYO CLINIC HOSPITAL ROCHESTER, 1216 SECOND STREET SOUTHWEST, ROCHESTER MN; measure OP_18b score, sample 611 sampled visits,
los_dc_median.note: CMS computes the median from a sample of 611 visits; interval = +/- 1.96 standard errors of a sample median of a lognormal stay with cv 0.9 (30 min). Excludes admitted, transferred and psychiatric patients; the simulator's discharged patients are compared.

lwbs_rate.label: Left without being seen, share of arrivals
lwbs_rate.source: CMS Care Compare OP-22: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 240010 MAYO CLINIC HOSPITAL ROCHESTER, 1216 SECOND STREET SOUTHWEST, ROCHESTER MN; measure OP_22 score 3 percent, denominator 84799
lwbs_rate.note: Published as a whole-number percent, so the true value is anywhere in the interval. The fit is indifferent inside +/- 0.3 points of the published value and penalises anything further out.

arrivals_per_day.label: ED arrivals per day
arrivals_per_day.source: ed_visits_per_year_cms: CMS Care Compare 'Timely and Effective Care - Hospital' (Provider Data Catalog yv7e-xc69, release 2026-08-13), Facility ID (CCN) 240010 MAYO CLINIC HOSPITAL ROCHESTER, 1216 SECOND STREET SOUTHWEST, ROCHESTER MN; denominator ('Sample') of measure OP_22 = total
arrivals_per_day.note: The arrival rate is a simulator input (patient.shared.arrivals_per_day), so this only checks the arrival process (hour/weekday/season profile over the simulated window).

ward_occupancy.label: Inpatient occupancy (modelled ward pool)
ward_occupancy.source: inpatient_occupancy: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 844481 for CCN 240010, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024 (report status code 1); Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14: inpatient days 312143 / bed days available 422690
ward_occupancy.note: Public figures: HCRIS cost report, annual, beds available: 0.738; HHS weekly capacity reports, staffed beds: 0.810, weekly range 0.74-0.84. Both are averages over ALL inpatient beds of the hospital; the simulator has one pool of beds that ED admissions compete for, and matching that pool's occupancy to the hospital-wide figure is an assumption. The fit aims at 0.738 (HCRIS cost report, annual, beds available); the acceptance interval spans the usable public figures +/- 3 points.

ed_salaries_per_day.label: ED salaries per day (wages, no benefits, no physicians)
ed_salaries_per_day.source: ed_salaries_per_year: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 844481 for CCN 240010, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024 (report status code 1); Worksheet A line 91 'EMERGENCY' + line 91.01 'EMERGENCY-TRAUMA CENTER', column 1 (salaries)
ed_salaries_per_day.note: Published: 82.7 k$/day (HCRIS Worksheet A line 91 column 1 = salaries the hospital pays in the Emergency cost centre, / 365). Compared with the simulator's wage bill WITHOUT benefits and WITHOUT attending / resident pay. Three things the report does not say widen the interval: it counts paid hours, the simulator worked hours (paid/worked 1.0 to 1.15 allowed); employed attending physicians may or may not be on the line (up to 12 % of the bill allowed); +/- 10 % for wage levels (the simulator uses BLS area wages). The fit aims at the middle of the interval. In the model this target mostly decides how many nurses are on the floor, which patient flow alone cannot identify.

fte_employees.citation: CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 844481 for CCN 240010, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024 (report status code 1); Worksheet S-3 Part I line 14 column 10 (employees on payroll, hospital)

notes: Public roster: 71 emergency physicians and 28 APPs. At 1500 / 1800 clinical hours a year (assumed) and residents covering 35 % of provider hours (assumed role mix) that caps provider-hours at 661 a day (2.85 per visit); the search upper bound is 1.60 per visit. A roster lists everyone affiliated, including part-time and multi-site clinicians, so it is an upper bound.
Nurse hours: the hospital's own ED salary bill (HCRIS) is a target, so nurse-hours per visit are searched from the literature low (1.16) up to 6.0 and the salary target decides.
